top_signals.title: Rubio Unveils Deals on Central Asia Push Against China, Russia
top_signals.summary: The US announced around $12 billion in deals as part of another push to broaden influence in resource-rich Central Asia, with Secretary of State Marco Rubio visiting Uzbekistan and saying American firms should compete in the region against Russia and China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The Pentagon Doesn’t Need to Reinvent Supply Chain Transparency
top_signals.summary:
As the United States seeks to rebuild its defense industrial base, Washington is scrambling to understand an industrial ecosystem that it no longer controls, nor largely understands. China has been able to achieve strategic advantage against the United States through the targeted application of export controls and licensing requirements on specific materials at specific supply chain nodes. U.S. responses, by contrast, have largely been broader in scope and shallower in effect. top_signals.title: Groups seek clarity on motive behind Pentagon’s study of women in combat
top_signals.summary: Citing concerns about Hegseth’s views on the topic, the lawsuit asks for records showing the scope, purpose, methodology and anticipated use of the study.

top_signals.title: Crypto.com, Novig sue Missouri over sports event contracts; Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood hold off
top_signals.summary: Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood and Underdog, which also received cease-and-desist orders, have not filed suits in Missouri, according to court records.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
